notes.8: Tag 7. A receive only accepts a message whose source, tag and communicator all match.

summaries.all: Run with 2 processes. Rank 1 sends, rank 0 receives, but the tags differ.
summaries.0: Rank 0 waits in MPI_Recv for tag 7 from rank 1. No such message ever arrives, so it hangs here and never prints.
summaries.1: Rank 1 sends x with tag 5. The send finishes (small messages are usually buffered), but nobody can receive the message.
